title: "Manuscript: MPX NYC Intervention Strategy"
---



```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
#| label: fig-radargender
#| fig-cap: "fig-radargender"
#| 


gender_id_labels <- c(
                      "cisgender-man" = "Cisgender\nMan", 
                      "non-binary" = "Non\nBinary", 
                      "cisgender-woman" = "Cisgender\nWoman",
                      "transgender-man" = "Transgender\nMan", 
                      "transgender-woman" = "Transgender\nWoman", 
                      "other" = "Other\nDemographic\nGroups"
                      )

  targets::tar_read(participant_data) %>%
    mutate(genderId = factor(genderId, names(gender_id_labels), gender_id_labels )) %>%
    group_by(genderId) %>%
    summarize(count = n()) %>%
    filter(!is.na(genderId)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(level = genderId) %>%
    mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot() + 
        ggplot2::geom_bar(aes(x = level, fill = level, y = proportion), width = 1, stat = "identity") + 
        ggplot2::theme_void() + 
        ggplot2::theme(
                        legend.position = "none", 
                        panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(size = 0.1),
                        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45),
                        axis.text.y = element_text()
                        ) + 
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(
                                              mpxnyc_colors$dark_blue, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$dark_pink, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$dark_purple, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$light_blue, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$light_pink, 
                                              mpxnyc_colors$light_purple,
                                              mpxnyc_colors$light_green)
          ) + 
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
      ) + 
    labs(
      title    = captions_and_titles("radargender")$title,
      subtitle = captions_and_titles("radargender")$subtitle,
      caption  = captions_and_titles("radargender")$caption
    )

```
